item.title: Claude Skills for Developers: SKILL.md That Survives Real Work
item.description: Teams misuse Claude Skills two ways: dumping grounds, or giant copy-pasted prompts that never graduate. Both are sloppy. Skills work through progressive disclosure — compact metadata first, full instructions only on task match — letting dozens stay available without bloating every session. Treat them like operations code, not prompt poetry.
